name: dota-current-skill-editor
description: Offline desktop ability editor for local Dota 2 cheat environments
author: Dota Current Skill Editor contributors

scripts.build: npm run build:assets && npm run verify:resources
scripts.test:ui: npm run prepare:electron && node tests/current-ability-ui.cjs && node tests/current-editor-ui.cjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run prepare:electron && electron-builder --config scripts/current-skill-editor-build.json --win dir
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests docs tools/current-ability/ui README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md package.json
